name: setup-reviewdog
description: Setup reviewdog for PR validation actions.

type.description: Report type: check (github-check), review (github-pr-review), or annotations (github-pr-check). When unset, auto-detects based on event context (PR events use annotations, others use check).

github-token.description: GitHub token for reviewdog reporting. Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN when empty. Left unset when neither is available; callers that require a token for reporting are responsible for erroring on that themselves.
